about.numbers+changes: Counts, minimums, distances, latencies, quotas, prices and dated changes: Region/AZ/POP counts (cite as retrieved on the snapshot date), 'at least three AZs', 'at least two AZs' for production, the availability 'nines' table, RTO/RPO definitions, CloudShell limits, multi-session count, Budgets cost, pricing principles. Every FRESHNESS and feed hypothesis (new Regions, framework major updates, new lenses, console Local Zones selector, CLI endpoints) re-grounded in a dated document-history or document-revisions row (quote the row) plus the current page; GA after 2026-07-15 is 'not examinable yet'. Use `tables` on the Regions table, the billing codes table and the availability table.
about.behavior+decisions: Definitions and can / cannot / only / by default rules: Region and AZ isolation, zonal vs Regional vs global services, control plane vs data plane, static stability, opt-in Regions, the shared responsibility split (of vs in; IaaS vs abstracted; inherited vs shared vs customer controls), the six pillars with design principles and best-practice areas, review process and HRIs, console / CLI / CloudShell behaviour and credential rules. Comparisons the exam hinges on (Multi-AZ vs multi-Region, POP vs Local Zone vs Region, Local Zones vs Wavelength vs Outposts, IaaS vs managed responsibilities), Callvale's Region decision facts and the three case studies.
about.faq: Quick-fire items with verbatim FAQ answers: `saa.py faq <url> --find` on the Well-Architected Tool FAQ (www/well-architected-tool/faqs), the Local Zones FAQ (www/about-aws/global-infrastructure/localzones/faqs), the console FAQ (www/console/faq-console) and the CloudShell FAQ if it parsed. One fact per item of kind faq, quoting the answer sentence.
